about_the_game:
A collection of the 5 soundtracks from SoulGame original Flash games: Swords & Souls, Rogue Soul 1 & 2, The Soul Driver and The Gentleman, for a total of 45 tracks retracing all the crazy Souls Adventures of your childhood!

All of SoulGame's soundtracks have been composed by me (Argl - Séverin Larose) and are a humble testimony of my childhood spent playing the Nintendo, with game such as Pokemon, Final Fantasy, Aladin, Street Fighter, Battletoads, and much more.

You'll find lots of crossover between games if you listen closely! That's because I love to re-use stuff and sometime a track just sounds good in another game.
